title: Silent together, restless apart
odia: ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନ କହେ, ନ ଦେଖିଲେ ପାଣି ନ ପିଏ
literal_meaning: On meeting, says nothing; without seeing, will not drink water.
explanation: The contradiction is the joke: someone seems distant in person but cannot settle when the other is absent.
meaning_odia: ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଥିଲେ କଥା କହୁନାହାନ୍ତି, ଦୂରେ ଗଲେ ମନ ଥୟ ହେଉନାହିଁ। ବାହାରର ଦୂରତା ଓ ଭିତରର ଟାଣର ଏହି ବିରୋଧାଭାସରେ କଥାଟିର ମଜା। ଏହା ଆଚରଣର ଅମେଳକୁ ଧରେ; ସେହି ମଣିଷର ମନ କଥା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଜାଣିହୋଇଗଲା ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Two friends barely speak during a visit, then immediately ask when they will meet again. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source labels this ଢଗ under meeting. It names no relationship or reason for the silence.

graphic.caption: Quiet together, missing the company apart.

odia_summary: ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନାହିଁ, ନଦେଖିଲେ ମନ ଥୟ ନାହିଁ—ଏହି ବିରୋଧାଭାସକୁ କଥାଟି ଧରିଛି।
english_summary: Someone stays silent in the other’s presence but cannot settle when they are apart.
